mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TB_SETTLEMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT ( SETTLE_ID, SETTLE_TYPE, RESV_ID, BIZ_NO, PAY_AMOUNT, FEE_RATE, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLE_STATUS, REG_DATE, BIZ_TYPE, SETTLE_MONTH, TOTAL_SALES, TOTAL_FEE, SETTLE_AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, PAY_DATE, REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, REQUEST_SCOPE, ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, REQUESTED_AT, APPROVED_AT, REJECT_REASON, PRODUCT_SALES_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{settleId}, #{settleType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{bizNo}, #{payAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{feeRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{feeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{settleStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{bizType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{settleMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalSales, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalFee, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{settleAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{requestId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{requestType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestScope, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roomId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{periodStart, jdbcType=DATE}, #{periodEnd, jdbcType=DATE}, #{requestedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{approvedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productSalesAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deliveryFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )

SELECT SEQ_TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM ( SETTLE_ITEM_ID, SETTLE_ID, ITEM_TYPE, RESV_ID, ROOM_ID, CHECKIN_DATE, CHECKOUT_DATE, RESV_AMOUNT, ORDER_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CONFIRMED_AT, ITEM_SALES_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_PAYER, FEE_RATE, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLE_AMOUNT, STATUS_CD, HOLD_REASON, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{settleItemId}, #{settleId}, NVL(#{itemType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ORDER_ITEM'), #{resvId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{roomId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{checkinDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{checkoutDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{resvAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{confirmedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{itemSalesAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deliveryFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeePayer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{settleAmount}, #{statusCd}, #{holdReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ( NVL(( SELECT SUM( (NVL(T.itemSalesAmount, 0) - ROUND(NVL(T.itemSalesAmount, 0) * NVL(T.feeRate, 5) / 100)) + NVL(T.deliveryFeeAmount, 0) ) FROM ( SELECT NVL(oi.TOTAL_PRICE, 0) AS itemSalesAmount, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY oi.ORDER_ID ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID ) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM si2 JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM oi2 ON oi2.ORDER_ITEM_ID = si2.ORDER_ITEM_ID WHERE oi2.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID AND NVL(si2.DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT, 0) > 0 AND si2.STATUS_CD IN ('INCLUDED', 'HOLD', 'EXCLUDED', 'REFUNDED') ) THEN NVL(o.DELIVERY_FEE, 0) ELSE 0 END AS deliveryFeeAmount, NVL(b.FEE_RATE, 5) AS feeRate FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN TB_ORDER o ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = oi.PRODUCT_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = NVL(o.BIZ_NO, p.BIZ_NO) WHERE NVL(o.BIZ_NO, p.BIZ_NO) = #{bizNo} AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL AND o.ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL' AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM si WHERE si.ORDER_ITEM_ID = oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID AND si.STATUS_CD IN ('INCLUDED', 'HOLD', 'EXCLUDED', 'REFUNDED') ) ) T ), 0) + NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT' ), 0) ) AS pendingAmount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE' AND ST.PAY_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND ST.PAY_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ), 0) AS paidAmount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.TOTAL_FEE) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' ), 0) AS totalFeeAmount FROM DUAL

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, ST.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, ST.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, ST.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, ST.PRODUCT_SALES_AMOUNT AS productSalesAmount, ST.DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT AS deliveryFeeAmount, ST.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE'
AND ST.SETTLE_MONTH = #{settleMonth}
AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'
ORDER BY ST.PERIOD_START DESC, ST.SETTLE_ID DESC
SELECT DISTINCT ST.SETTLE_MONTH FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND ST.SETTLE_MONTH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST.SETTLE_MONTH DESC

SELECT SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID AS settleItemId, SI.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, NVL(SI.ITEM_TYPE, 'ORDER_ITEM') AS itemType, SI.ORDER_ID AS orderId, SI.ORDER_ITEM_ID AS orderItemId, SI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, SI.CONFIRMED_AT AS confirmedAt, SI.ITEM_SALES_AMOUNT AS itemSalesAmount, SI.DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT AS deliveryFeeAmount, SI.RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT AS returnFeeAmount, SI.RETURN_FEE_PAYER AS returnFeePayer, SI.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, SI.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, SI.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, SI.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, SI.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason, SI.REG_DATE AS regDate, NVL(O.ORDER_NO, TO_CHAR(SI.ORDER_ID)) AS orderNo, NVL(SI_PROD.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI JOIN TB_SETTLEMENT ST ON ST.SETTLE_ID = SI.SETTLE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = SI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM SI_PROD ON SI_PROD.ORDER_ITEM_ID = SI.ORDER_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = SI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SI.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' ORDER BY SI.CONFIRMED_AT ASC, SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID ASC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, BIZ_NO AS bizNo, STATUS_CD AS statusCd FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME ASC, PRODUCT_ID ASC

INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST ( REQUEST_ID, BIZ_NO, REQUEST_SCOPE, ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, TARGET_START, TARGET_END, STATUS_CD, REQUEST_MEMO, REQUESTED_AT ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{bizNo}, #{requestScope}, #{roomId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{targetStart}, #{targetEnd}, #{statusCd}, #{requestMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, BIZ_NO AS bizNo, REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, ROOM_ID AS roomId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, TARGET_START AS targetStart, TARGET_END AS targetEnd, STATUS_CD AS statusCd, REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, REQUESTED_AT AS requestedAt, APPROVED_AT AS approvedAt, REJECTED_AT AS rejectedAt FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST WHERE BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED', APPROVED_AT = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL, REJECTED_AT = NULL WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REJECTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
